test_title: PYST 63: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.

Capable of being done
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "Feasible" means capable of being done or carried out, which matches the given phrase.

Hence, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Correct Word:** Feasible

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Suitable – Refers to being appropriate but not necessarily capable of being done.
 
• **Option 3:** Practical – Implies utility but lacks the direct meaning of feasibility.
 
• **Option 4:** Useful – Describes something beneficial but not directly related to being achievable.
